results.title: Nigeria's grid operator blames gas shortages, low water for power slump - Businessday NG
results.snippet:
Gas dependence is the central weakness of Nigeria’s power system. Most of the country’s grid capacity comes from gas-fired plants, so any disruption to fuel deliveries, whether from pipeline problems, supply shortfalls or payment disputes, quickly shows up in the amount of power available.

results.title: Nigeria's Aliko Dangote steps in to boost Cameroon's oil supply
results.snippet:
Audio By Vocalize

Africa's richest man, Nigerian tycoon Aliko Dangote, has agreed to step in and bolster Cameroon's supply of refined petroleum products, the West African nation's refinery company Sonara has announced.
